said.text: Flare guns were never designed to be weapons, but they are now being weaponized and used to inflict destruction, panic, and pain within our communities… These bills ensures that we treat flare guns as what they have become in many dangerous cases: weapons capable of real harm.

did.text: Voted Yes on S8455-B, which establishes the crimes of criminal sale of a flare gun in the first and second degrees and sets restrictions on and requirements for the sale of flare guns. Passed Senate 35–25.

whyNote: The statement is from Sen.
